Designer finishes will provide a lifetime of use. Crafted from the finest solid brass materials Heavy base will help prevent tipping European style hook makes changing the roll quick and easy Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes Limited Lifetime Warranty Assembled in the USA Specification & Documentation Product dimensions, in.
